description: This PHP source file defines the CallsQuickCreate class, which extends QuickCreate, and handles the creation of 'Calls' in the SuiteCRM system. It includes methods to process form data, initialize default values, assign template variables, and generate JavaScript and HTML for the quick create interface.

classes.name: CallsQuickCreate
classes.description: A class that extends QuickCreate to handle quick creation of Call records, including setting up the form, default values, and interface elements.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Prepares the form for creating a new Call, setting default values for start date/time, duration, and options for time fields, and assigns variables to the Smarty template.
